title: Google AI Mode Can Now Read Your Wallet, Drive and Gemini Chats
dek: Opt-in Personal Intelligence brings your spending and files into Search.

facts.label: Docs, sheets and PDFs in coming weeks
App chats carry over into AI Mode soon

caption:
Google Search might soon know your spending habits better than you do. 💳

Google is expanding Personal Intelligence in Search. AI Mode can now connect to Google Wallet, with Google Drive files and Gemini app chats coming in the next few weeks. They join Gmail, Calendar and Photos, which could already feed personal context into Search.

Wallet access is read-only: AI Mode can help you trim spending and get more from cash-back and reward points, but it can't move or invest your money. Drive can pull scattered docs, sheets and PDFs into one answer, like a tax season plan. Everything is opt-in and can be switched off anytime in Search Personalization.

Helpful or too much data for Google? We break it down at AI Parabellum. Would you connect your apps?
